name: @odu/web-acceptance
//scripts: Bun hosts the runner, and `test` NAMES cucumber's entry FILE so that it does — never the `cucumber-js` bin, whose `#!/usr/bin/env node` shebang is resolved against PATH and hands the suite to whatever node the host happens to have. runner.test.ts pins the spelling, and says why a unit pin rather than trust in this leg. Keep it a path: this one is stable because the isolated linker (bunfig.toml) gives every workspace member its own direct dependencies.
//devDependencies: playwright is pinned EXACTLY to 1.61.1 — the version of `pkgs.playwright-driver` in the npins-pinned nixpkgs. The npm package ships only the driver's JS; the browsers come from the Nix store via PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH (flake.nix's `e2e` shell), and the driver refuses a browser build it was not compiled against. A drift does not fail at install time — it fails at `chromium.launch()` with "Executable doesn't exist", pointing at a store path that is real but wrong. Bump this only together with the nixpkgs pin. Two things enforce that here rather than trusting this paragraph: pins.test.ts refuses a caret or tilde, and support/hooks.ts compares this version against PLAYWRIGHT_DRIVER_VERSION before the first scenario runs.
